definitions.gloss: ride comfort; how comfortable a ride is
definitions.explanation: The quality of comfort experienced when riding in a vehicle.

examples.japanese: この{車|くるま}は{乗|の}り{心地|ごこち}がいい。
examples.english: This car has a comfortable ride.

examples.japanese: {新幹線|しんかんせん}の{乗|の}り{心地|ごこち}は{最高|さいこう}だ。
examples.english: The ride quality of the shinkansen is excellent.

examples.japanese: {乗|の}り{心地|ごこち}の{良|よ}い{自転車|じてんしゃ}を{探|さが}している。
examples.english: I'm looking for a bicycle with a comfortable ride.

notes:
WORD FORMATION:
{乗|の}る (to ride) + {心地|ここち} (feeling, sensation) → feeling while riding

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
・{乗|の}り{心地|ごこち}がいい / {良|よ}い (comfortable ride)
・{乗|の}り{心地|ごこち}が{悪|わる}い (uncomfortable ride)
・{乗|の}り{心地|ごこち}の{良|よ}い{車|くるま} (a car with good ride quality)

RELATED ～{心地|ごこち} WORDS:
・{居心地|いごこち} (comfort of a place)
・{寝心地|ねごこち} (sleeping comfort)
・{着心地|きごこち} (wearing comfort)
・{使|つか}い{心地|ごこち} (ease of use)

USAGE NOTE:
Applies to any vehicle: cars, trains, bicycles, motorcycles, etc. Often used in reviews and advertisements.
